purpose: Establish authoritative real-world event identity, occurrence/release date-time where available, and primary-source provenance; then adjudicate pre-truth candidate duplicate links. This stage must not inspect linked-asset realized returns or select events based on prediction-market performance.

identity_policy.rule: Never silently rewrite W4CE1 IDs. Map one or more pretruth exact groups to a separately minted official_event_id after authoritative evidence.
identity_policy.official_event_reference_date: UTC calendar date of the authoritative occurrence/release/decision. Preserve exact source timestamp separately when the official source publishes it.
identity_policy.official_subject_key: Use the frozen W4-B family-specific subject semantics. For macro releases use the existing US_* subject key; for entity-specific events preserve the normalized subject/entity identity supported by official evidence.
identity_policy.date_correction: A venue end/expiration date may differ from the official occurrence date. Record the delta and mapping; do not mutate or delete the pretruth ID.

PAYROLLS_JOBS_RELEASE: BLS archived Employment Situation news release

US_UNEMPLOYMENT_RATE: BLS archived Employment Situation news release
US_INITIAL_JOBLESS_CLAIMS: U.S. Department of Labor Employment and Training Administration Unemployment Insurance Weekly Claims release

PCE_RELEASE: BEA Personal Income and Outlays news release
RETAIL_SALES_RELEASE: U.S. Census Bureau Advance Monthly Sales for Retail and Food Services release
FDA_FINAL_PDUFA_DECISION: SEC/issuer filing describing FDA action only when the FDA action document is not public
EARNINGS_EPS: SEC EDGAR 8-K/10-Q/10-K/6-K filing containing or attaching earnings release
MA_PRE_ANNOUNCEMENT_OR_RUMOR: SEC filing/issuer announcement for actual announced transaction when applicable
MA_PENDING_COMPLETION: SEC filing/issuer closing or termination announcement
MA_REGULATORY_CLEARANCE: FTC/DOJ/other named official competition regulator decision
SEC/issuer filing describing the regulator action when regulator primary document is unavailable
CORPORATE_LITIGATION_BINARY: SEC filing/issuer official release for settlement or material case outcome when court document is not publicly retrievable

evidence_contract.source_capture: Hash the retrieved official body/document whenever technically possible. If anti-bot or access restrictions prevent deterministic capture, record URL, authority, retrieval timestamp, HTTP/access status and structured evidence reference; never fabricate a hash.
evidence_contract.future_or_not_yet_occurred: An event whose official occurrence is after the W4-B historical cutoff or has not yet occurred cannot become final historical backtest N; retain it as NOT_HISTORICAL_YET rather than forcing a truth label.

candidate_edge_adjudication.same_rule: Two exact groups merge only if authoritative evidence maps both to the same official_event_id.
candidate_edge_adjudication.distinct_rule: Two exact groups remain distinct if both are verified and map to different official_event_id values.
candidate_edge_adjudication.unresolved_rule: If either side lacks adequate authoritative identity evidence, do not merge and do not claim the component as final-independent N.
candidate_edge_adjudication.transitivity: Final official-event groups are connected components of CONFIRMED_SAME_OFFICIAL_EVENT edges plus exact W4CE1 aliases. Distinct edges must not exist within a final component; such a contradiction fails the gate.

firewall.policy: Prefer dates/times/titles/identifiers. Economic release values, linked-asset responses, and prediction-market outcomes are unnecessary for identity and remain closed unless a later protocol explicitly authorizes them.

gate.final_verified_unique_n_definition: Count of unique official_event_id values among VERIFIED_OFFICIAL_TRUTH records after candidate-edge adjudication.
